name: roxmltree-source-ranges
instr:
Please add source tracking for decoded text and attribute values in `/app`, so a caller can highlight the original XML spelling of a byte in a parsed value. Don't add new crates.

With the `positions` feature, expose these methods:
- `roxmltree::Node::text_source_range(&self, offset: usize) -> Option<core::ops::Range<usize>>`
- `roxmltree::Attribute::value_source_range(&self, offset: usize) -> Option<core::ops::Range<usize>>`

Offsets are zero-based UTF-8 byte offsets in the decoded text node or attribute value. Return a half-open byte range in `Document::input_text()`. Every byte of a Unicode scalar maps to the scalar's complete original spelling. A character reference maps to its whole reference, and a normalized CRLF maps to both source bytes. CDATA delimiters contribute no bytes. For example, in `<r>é&</r>`, offsets 0 and 1 map to `3..5`, and offset 2 maps to `5..10`.

For content produced by a general entity, use the whole outermost entity reference in the main document, not a range in its declaration or resolver-supplied text. This applies to text and attribute values produced by markup inside the expansion as well. Ordinary source tracking resumes after the expansion. Track the decoded values actually produced by the parser, including its existing normalization rules and merging of adjacent text and CDATA. `text_source_range` applies only to text nodes, not an element's `text()` convenience view. Both methods return `None` when the offset is outside the decoded val
